transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I just don’t really care about anything anymore. Stuff I used to do—art classes, game nights, hiking… even trying to get back on the soccer team. I mostly just sit in my room and let everything slip.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since… not long after my divorce. So, almost two years, I guess. About a year and eleven months.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like, or has the pleasure gone away?
Yeah… it’s mostly gone. I don’t really get anything out of art classes or game nights anymore. Hiking, soccer… I just don’t care enough to go. I mostly stay in my room and let it all slide.
Do you often think about your divorce or other past events in a way that feels sad or regretful?

Yeah… I do. I go over the divorce a lot. Like every small thing I said wrong, or didn’t do right. And not just that—friends too. I just… I feel like I’ve been a burden, like people would be better off if I wasn’t around.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?

…Yeah. I mean, I haven’t wanted to wake up sometimes. It’s been… a lot.

When my friend found me, I was saying I couldn’t keep living like this. I don’t really like talking about it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Yeah… I think so. I don’t really eat much most days. Food just tastes like cardboard, and my jeans are loose enough now that I have to kind of knot the waistband.
Do you find yourself moving slower or faster than usual, or having trouble sitting still?

Yeah… both, I guess. Some days I just pace back and forth, like from the kitchen to the window, over and over until my legs hurt. Other times I’m so slowed down that even making coffee feels… heavy. Like moving through wet cement.
Do you often feel guilty about things that have happened?

Yeah… a lot. I keep going over things I did wrong, especially in my marriage and with friends. Little stuff too. It just… it feels like I’m a burden, like maybe people would be better off without me around.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?
Not really. I used to do art classes, board-game nights… hiking sometimes. I kept thinking I’d get back to soccer too. But now I just… don’t care. I mostly sit in my room and let it all slip away.
Have you had periods where your depression symptoms got significantly better for a while?
Not really. It kind of settled in around the next summer and… stayed. It’s been about a year and four months now, I think.
How long have you been feeling this way without any significant improvement?
Since around the next summer… it just kind of stayed. So… about a year and four months, I guess, without really getting better.
Have you had other periods of feeling this low before the divorce?
I… don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had bad times before, but I’m not sure it was like this. I don’t remember it being this low for this long.
Have you ever felt this low before the divorce?
I don’t think so… not like this. Most days now I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like… there isn’t really anything ahead of me outside these apartment walls.

Has this feeling of not caring and being disconnected from things you used to enjoy been continuous since your divorce, or have you had periods where it felt like it was getting better, even if it didn't completely go away?
It’s been pretty much continuous. I don’t really care about the things I used to… art classes, game nights, hiking. I mostly just stay in my room and let it all pass by.
How long have you been feeling this low without any improvement?
Since around the summer after… after everything changed. It’s been about a year and four months, I guess. It hasn’t really lifted.
Has this low feeling you're experiencing been continuous for more than two years now?
No… not more than two years. It got constant around that next summer, so… about a year and four months.
Has this low feeling you're experiencing lasted for two years or more now?
No… not two years. It’s been more like about a year and four months, since it got constant that summer.
Has this low feeling you're experiencing lasted for less than two years?
Yes… less than two years. Around a year and four months since it really stayed that way.
Has your current episode of depression lasted for less than two years?
Yes… it’s been less than two years. About a year and four months, I think.
Have you had any episodes of depression like this before the one that started after your divorce?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had rough periods before, but I don’t know if I’d call them the same as this.
